project.name: frank
project.description: 弗兰克 (Frank) is an identity-aware home assistant that uses facial recognition, voiceprint recognition, and multi-modal sensor fusion to recognize family members and provide personalized services including conversation, task management, reminders, and scheduling. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Frank is an identity-aware home assistant. Start with the README to understand the project purpose, then explore the package manifest for dependencies and scripts.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The Electron main process is the application entry point. It manages app lifecycle, spawns the Python backend, handles WebSocket communication, and creates the system tray.

tour.title: Renderer Bridge & Frontend
tour.description: The preload script exposes a secure API to the sandboxed renderer. The main frontend app manages panels (identity, settings, tasks, chat), the orb animation, and member management.

tour.title: Python Backend Server
tour.description: The WebSocket server is the central hub for all backend communication. It routes messages to modules (camera, audio, members, skills), manages state, and broadcasts identity events.

tour.title: Identity Fusion Engine
tour.description: The core identity system fuses face and voice embeddings for multi-modal recognition. The state machine manages identity transitions (unknown → tentative → confirmed).

tour.title: Camera & Face Recognition Pipeline
tour.description: Real-time face detection using InsightFace/MediaPipe, face embedding extraction, multi-person tracking with ReID, quality gating, and face thumbnail capture.

tour.title: Audio Pipeline & Voice Recognition
tour.description: Voice activity detection, wake word detection, speech-to-text via Whisper, and voiceprint embedding extraction for speaker identification.

tour.title: Member Management & Database
tour.description: Member CRUD operations, unidentified person tracking, identity conversion, role management, and the SQLite database with schema migrations, embedding storage, and similarity search.

tour.title: LLM Integration & Skills
tour.description: LLM provider integration for conversation intelligence, text-to-speech output, and the plugin/skill system for extensible agent capabilities.

tour.title: Configuration & Project Structure
tour.description: Project configuration (frank.yaml), build scripts, dependency management, and the OpenSpec specification system for tracking feature proposals and design decisions.
